text:
Nina (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hybrid/office ops: travel, desk hoteling, reimbursements. Drop short Qs and we'll answer.
Alex: Are we still running the remote allowance pilot for EU folks?
Nina (People Ops): Yes  small EU pilot continues through Q3. If you think you qualify DM me location + role.
Maya: Clarify desk waitlist: I added myself but got no update.
Nina (People Ops): Waitlist processes every 24h. If you need same-week access, ping #people-ops with "desk-urgent" and ops-bot will create a ticket.
Ken: Can we expense courier shipping personal gear to a hub for a week?
Nina (People Ops): We only cover shipping of company-owned equipment. Personal items are personal. If there's a compelling reason, ask your manager first.
Priya: Visa assistance for long exchanges  company covers fees?
Nina (People Ops): For company-directed stays >30 days we handle visa fees and vendor support. Start a ticket with dates/location.
Alex: Parking: is EV charging reimbursed?
Nina (People Ops): Yes for company visits. Use HUB_PARK code and attach receipt. Daily commute charging not covered.
Maya: What about caregiving while traveling for mandatory offsites?
Nina (People Ops): We can reimburse reasonable caregiving costs (e.g., extra childcare) when travel is required. Code as CAREGIVING and get manager pre-approval.
Ken: If manager books via corporate card, do we still need Concur approvals?
Nina (People Ops): Yes  expenses need manager approval in Concur even if charged on corporate card. Ops audits monthly.
Priya: How long for reimbursements?
Nina (People Ops): Usually 7-10 business days after approval. For urgent needs, DM people-ops and we'll expedite.
Alex: Any changes to the offsite stipend amount?
Nina (People Ops): No change right now. Small team offsites up to $500/person reimbursable; ops will confirm for larger events.
ops-bot: calendar: Created "All-Hands Ops: Travel & Desk Followups" and attached Nina's notes.
Nina (People Ops): I'll post a one-pager with common Concur codes (OPS_OFFSITE, HUB_PARK, COWORK_DAY, HEALTH_CLEARANCE, VISA_DOC, EQUIP_SHIP, CAREGIVING, REMOTE_ALLOWANCE) and a 3-min Loom by EOD. DM for exceptions.
